decisions.title: Use Dafny for core engine
decisions.context: The pipeline engine has complex scheduling and state transitions that benefit from formal verification.
decisions.decision: All core modules (DAG resolver, scheduler, executor, evaluator, artifact manager, notification) are implemented in Dafny with verified contracts.
decisions.consequences: Higher confidence in correctness, but requires Dafny toolchain and may have a learning curve.

decisions.title: In-memory artifact storage
decisions.context: The initial version does not require persistent artifact storage across runs.
decisions.decision: Artifacts are stored in memory for the duration of the pipeline run.
decisions.consequences: Simpler implementation, but artifacts are lost after the process exits.

openRisks.mitigation: Limit pipeline size and use modular verification.
openRisks.description: Dafny verification may be slow for large pipeline definitions.

openRisks.mitigation: Use Dafny contracts to prove mutual exclusion and proper synchronization.
openRisks.description: Parallel execution may introduce race conditions if not carefully modeled.

components.name: PipelineContracts
components.internals: Pure datatypes and enums. No logic beyond type definitions. Used by all other modules.

testCases.name: PipelineDefinition has at least one job
testCases.description: A valid PipelineDefinition must contain at least one JobDefinition.

components.responsibility: Defines core datatypes for pipeline definitions, job status, step status, retry policies, and expression evaluation results.

components.name: DagResolver
components.internals: Uses graph traversal pattern. Builds adjacency from job dependencies. Detects cycles via DFS. Returns topological order for scheduling.

testCases.name: Resolve linear pipeline
testCases.description: Given jobs A->B->C, Resolve returns a DAG with topological order [A,B,C].
testCases.expectedBehavior: Topological order is [A,B,C] and HasCycle is false.

testCases.name: Detect cycle
testCases.description: Given jobs A->B, B->A, Resolve reports a cycle.
testCases.expectedBehavior: HasCycle returns true and topological order is empty.

components.responsibility: Resolves a pipeline definition into a directed acyclic graph (DAG) of jobs, detecting cycles and computing topological order.

components.name: JobScheduler
components.internals: Uses scheduler pattern. Maintains a queue of ready jobs. Tracks completion counts per dependency. Supports parallel dispatch of independent jobs.

testCases.name: Schedule parallel jobs
testCases.description: Given two independent jobs, Schedule returns both as ready.

testCases.name: Respect dependencies
testCases.description: Given A->B, B is not ready until A completes.
testCases.expectedBehavior: GetReadyJobs initially returns only A; after MarkCompleted(A), returns B.

components.responsibility: Schedules jobs from the resolved DAG, respecting dependencies and enabling parallel execution of independent jobs.

components.name: StepExecutor
components.internals: Uses state-machine pattern for step lifecycle (pending, running, succeeded, failed, skipped). Evaluates conditions via ExpressionEvaluator. Applies retry policy on failure.

testCases.name: Conditional step skipped
testCases.description: A step with condition 'false' is skipped.
testCases.expectedBehavior: ShouldRun returns false and step status becomes skipped.

testCases.name: Retry on failure
testCases.description: A step that fails once succeeds on retry with retry policy maxRetries=2.
testCases.expectedBehavior: ExecuteStep returns succeeded after one retry.

components.responsibility: Executes individual steps within a job, handling conditional execution, retry policies, and step status transitions.

components.name: ExpressionEvaluator
components.internals: Uses parser pattern to tokenize and evaluate simple boolean and arithmetic expressions. Supports variables from pipeline context.
components.responsibility: Evaluates expressions used in conditional steps and retry policies, returning a boolean or value result.

components.name: ArtifactManager
components.internals: Uses repository pattern. Maintains a map of artifact ID to artifact data. Supports CRUD operations.

testCases.name: List artifacts
testCases.description: After storing two artifacts, ListArtifacts returns both IDs.
testCases.expectedBehavior: ListArtifacts returns a set containing both IDs.

components.responsibility: Stores and retrieves build artifacts produced by steps, with unique identifiers and metadata.

components.name: NotificationSystem
components.internals: Uses observer pattern. Maintains a list of subscribers. Notify dispatches events to all subscribers.

testCases.name: Notify subscribers
testCases.description: After subscribing a handler, Notify('job failed') invokes the handler.
testCases.expectedBehavior: The handler receives the notification message.

testCases.name: Unsubscribe stops notifications
testCases.description: After unsubscribing, Notify does not invoke the handler.

components.responsibility: Sends notifications about pipeline events (success, failure, retry) to configured channels.

components.name: PipelineEngine
components.internals: Uses pipeline pattern. Coordinates DagResolver, JobScheduler, StepExecutor, ArtifactManager, and NotificationSystem. Exposes a single entry point for running a pipeline.

testCases.name: Run simple pipeline
testCases.description: Given a pipeline with one job and one step, RunPipeline completes successfully.
testCases.expectedBehavior: RunPipeline returns success and notification is sent.

testCases.name: Run pipeline with failure
testCases.description: Given a pipeline where a step fails after retries, RunPipeline returns failure.
testCases.expectedBehavior: RunPipeline returns failure and failure notification is sent.

components.responsibility: Orchestrates the entire pipeline: resolve DAG, schedule jobs, execute steps, manage artifacts, and send notifications.

components.name: Cli
components.internals: Reads pipeline definition from file, invokes PipelineEngine, prints results to console.

testCases.name: CLI runs pipeline from file
testCases.description: Given a valid pipeline definition file, the CLI runs the pipeline and prints success.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Exit code 0 and success message printed.

testCases.name: CLI reports invalid file
testCases.description: Given a missing file, the CLI prints an error and exits non-zero.
testCases.expectedBehavior: Exit code non-zero and error message printed.

components.responsibility: Provides a command-line interface to trigger pipeline runs and display results.

dataStores.name: ArtifactStore
dataStores.schema: ArtifactId: string, Data: string, Metadata: map<string,string>

systemContext: A CI/CD pipeline engine that resolves pipeline definitions into a DAG, schedules and executes jobs and steps with support for parallel execution, conditional steps, and retry policies, evaluates expressions, manages artifacts, and sends notifications.

qualityAttributes.target: All pipeline execution logic verified by Dafny
qualityAttributes.rationale: CI/CD pipelines must not have race conditions or incorrect dependency handling.
Reduce pipeline execution time by running independent jobs concurrently.
Transient failures should not fail the entire pipeline.

deploymentTopology: Single process running the CLI, with in-memory artifact storage.
